summary: Kerb where cars already park, but homes sit 10 to 16 m behind it.
reasons: Several cars parked along this kerb

best_section.where: south kerb of Stanley Terrace just west of the junction, by the parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Moorak Court apartments 12 m away at the start; house 8 m away at 24 m, so the section stops short of it.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel parking bay beside the lane with parked cars in both images; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through road, but cars park along the kerb so a van blends in.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along this kerb in both images; sign 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 6 to 7% grade, 12.8% max over the full stretch
Dwellings 10 to 16 m on the section's own side
sun_shade: Part shaded by street trees from the south; open to morning and midday sun.
